$comment: EXP-1172: inline pictures. MCP exponential_sessions_show files ONE picture into coding_sessions.results like a sessions_results picture plus `inline: true` and an optional `caption` (the call's text), default topic `Progress`, and answers with the attachment's id as `id`, so the engine's tool preview carries it (`preview.id`). A transcript row of an `exponential_sessions_show` call (contract expToolDisplay result kind `picture`) renders the picture whose attachmentId == preview.id as ONE tile under the row, once the call SETTLED and the picture is in the synced results (an upload still in flight renders nothing yet): height inlineTileHeight fitted to the column (sessionResultTileHeightFitting with that base), caption line = tileCaption (the caption, else the label), tap = the client's existing lightbox. The tile sits where the call sits, so pictures read in publish order, newest at the bottom. A run of consecutive show calls (the EXP-948 same-tool group, "Showed 2 pictures") draws its calls' tiles in call order under the group caption even while the group is FOLDED: a picture never hides in a fold. Readers: a picture's `inline` is true only for a JSON true; `caption` is trimmed, blank = null. The Results face folds: every group reader moves a topic's INLINE pictures into `earlier` (publish order) unless the topic has exactly ONE picture; `entries` keeps the rest. A non-empty `earlier` renders under the group's tiles as a collapsed `earlierLabel · N` row that expands in place to the same tiles; Results-face tiles, Earlier ones included, keep the LABEL as their caption line (tileCaption is the transcript's). Mirrored by packages/ui session-results.ts, desktop session_results.rs, iOS SessionResults.swift, Android SessionResults.kt.

groups.name: no inline pictures keep today's groups
a topic's only picture stays even when inline
inline pictures fold under earlier beside the final ones
a progress topic of inline pictures folds whole

lookup.name: the call's picture by id, its caption on the tile
without a caption the tile reads the label
an upload still in flight (or a removed picture) renders nothing
a blank id and a text entry never match
